title.value: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network
title.justification: The title of the paper clearly states the focus on optimizing cellular network performance using graph neural networks.
title.quote: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network

extractions.description: The paper proposes a learning-based framework using auto-grouping graph convolutional networks (AGGCN) for handover parameter configuration in cellular networks, aiming to improve network throughput and reduce maintenance costs.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions its contribution to achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs).
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Thus, improving the cellular network has both economic and social impact towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs)

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing cellular network performance, leading to more efficient energy consumption and resource utilization in mobile communication.
primary_category.quote: Optimizing the performance of cellular networks and providing massive connectivity with improved coverage and user experience has a considerable social and economic impact on our daily life.

secondary_categories.justification: The optimization of cellular networks can lead to reduced maintenance costs and more efficient resource allocation, which aligns with sustainable finance principles.
secondary_categories.quote: It has the potential to massively reduce costs arising from human expert intervention and maintenance.

primary_sub_category.justification: The improvement of cellular networks can enable better communication and connectivity for transportation systems, including autonomous vehicles.
primary_sub_category.quote: The rapid growth in the number of devices that need real time, high quality connection to the internet (e.g., internet of things (IoT) devices, health monitoring equipment, devices used for online education and remote working, autonomous vehicles, etc.) makes it essential to improve cellular network performance.

applications.value: Alternatives to transportation such as virtual communication
applications.justification: Improved cellular networks can facilitate virtual communication, reducing the need for physical transportation.
